what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Azerbaijan by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025 both sources give the same figure, 657155 people.
Refugees from Azerbaijan live mainly in Armenia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh) territory, between the government of Azerbaijan and the Republic of Artsakh, in several years from 2005 to 2023, at war level in 2020.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Azerbaijan in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure stayed between 543400 and 735455 from 2009 to 2025.
IDMC records new displacements from conflict only from 2020, the year they were highest.
UNHCR's figures for people displaced inside Azerbaijan go back to 1993.

how.text: UNHCR's and IDMC's figures overlap and are counted differently, so they are shown side by side and never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Azerbaijan people moved to.
